requirement_text: Your admission average will be the average of your top six Grade 12 courses (U or M courses for Ontario students) including the courses which are required for the program you're applying to. If you take more than six Grade 12 courses, we'll calculate your admission average using your six highest grades, including the courses which are required for admission to your program of interest. Ontario C (college), O (open), and co-op courses are not used when calculating your admission average.

requirement_text: Applicants must have a high school diploma or equivalent with a minimum of six Grade 12 U or M courses, including all required courses. All offers of admission are conditional upon completing the Ontario Secondary School Diploma and maintaining the minimum grades listed on your offer of admission.

requirement_text: Waterloo can use Grade 11 marks and mid-term or predicted grades for Grade 12 courses to make a conditional offer of admission. For the School of Architecture, Waterloo uses grade 11 and grade 12 grades to select students for the interview and portfolio stage. Admission decisions are made between December and May depending on the program and whether the applicant is an Ontario high school student or not; most offers of admission are made in May. It does not matter where a program is ranked on the application -- Waterloo examines each application equally. Applicants may apply to a maximum of three programs at Waterloo, except Engineering, where only one program may be selected per application.
